Name: Better Friendship
Author: urbanyeti
Description:
[size=5][b]Ditch the menus! See real-time gift suggestions based on the items in your inventory![/b][/size]

[size=3][i]Are you tired of constantly having to dig through multiple wiki pages or mod menus every time you want to give a villager a gift? Wouldn't it be easier if there was just a visual indicator of who can receive a gift and who you can talk to? You deserve [b]Better Friendship[/b]![/i][/size]

[size=2][b]Update 1.2.0 (2026/11/10): New options based on your requests![/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Bubble size:[/b] scale the bubbles anywhere from 50% to 200%.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Fade in/out:[/b] bubbles now gently fade in and out instead of popping. You can adjust the fade time or turn it off.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Only Suggest Known Tastes:[/b] an immersion option that only suggests gifts whose taste you've already discovered for that villager.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Gift reminder without suggestions:[/b] set Gift Suggestion Preference to "Hide all suggestions" and keep "Display Generic Gift Prompts" on to see who can receive a gift without being told what to give.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Fixed resetting the config to defaults not fully applying until the game was restarted.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2][i]Heads up: if you already use "Hide all suggestions", you'll now see the generic gift reminder. Turn off "Display Generic Gift Prompts" to hide it again.[/i][/size]

[size=2][color=#6aa84f][b]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.14+ on Linux, Mac, and Windows[/b]. [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Requires SMAPI 4.1.0 or later.[/url][/color][/size]

[left][img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/QV6wsQEJPypTFPvyCR/200.gif[/img][/left]
[size=5]Features[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Each villager shows an at-a-glance display of whether they can receive gifts or want to be talked to![/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Simple gift suggestions based on what you are currently carrying![/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Customizable preferences with built-in config menu (requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url])[/size]
[list]
[*]Toggle for the prompts to speak with villagers[/*]
[*]Set minimum level of gift suggestions to display (e.g. Only show "loved" gifts)[/*]
[*]Customize the number of suggestions to cycle through and time in between cycling[/*]
[*]Ability to disable prompts when friendships are maxed and can't decay[/*]
[*]Preference to only display the highest quality available for each item[/*]
[*]Immersion options: only suggest gifts whose taste you've already discovered, or show a gift reminder without any specific suggestions[/*]
[*]Adjust the bubble size and fade in/out time[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][size=5]Install [/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3](optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy config setting management.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list]
